description: This file contains a static utility class 'TestingUtils' with various helper methods for testing in the Orleans framework, including logging configuration, trace file creation, waiting for conditions asynchronously, timeout multiplication, and thread pool configuration.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: A static class providing various testing utility methods for logging, file management, asynchronous waiting, timeout calculations, and thread pool configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureDefaultLoggingBuilder
methods.description: Configures an ILoggingBuilder to add a FileLoggerProvider that logs to the specified file path.

methods.name: CreateTraceFileName
methods.description: Creates a trace log filename for a specific node and cluster, ensuring the logs directory exists.

methods.name: CreateDefaultLoggerFactory
methods.description: Creates a default ILoggerFactory with file and console logging, using optional filters.

methods.name: WaitUntilAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a predicate returns true or a timeout occurs, with optional delay between retries.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies a TimeSpan by a double value, returning the scaled TimeSpan.

methods.name: ConfigureThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures ThreadPool and ServicePointManager settings for storage-related tests.
